# Getting help

| You want to | Go to |
|-------------|-------|
| Install or configure MxTac | [docs/installation.md](../docs/installation.md), [docs/configuration.md](../docs/configuration.md) |
| Connect Wazuh, Zeek, Suricata, syslog or a webhook | [docs/user-guide.md](../docs/user-guide.md#source-integration-guide) |
| Write or debug a Sigma rule | [docs/sigma-rules.md](../docs/sigma-rules.md) |
| Report a bug | [Open a bug report](https://github.com/fankh/mxtac/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml) |
| Propose a feature | [Open a feature request](https://github.com/fankh/mxtac/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml). Read the project scope in [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md#scope-of-the-project) first |
| Report a vulnerability | Follow [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). Do not open a public issue |

Before you open an issue, check the [current limitations](../README.md#current-limitations) and search the existing issues.

MxTac is maintained on a best-effort basis. There is no guaranteed response time and no commercial support for this repository. For a managed detection and response service with analysts and an SLA, see [KYRA MDR](https://kyramdr.com/en/?utm_source=mxtac&utm_medium=support).
